onboarding.creator: I'm a creator
onboarding.cityHint: Many brands look for creators in a specific area — for events, store visits or local campaigns. Your city lets them find you.
onboarding.bioHint: The first thing brands read about you. Briefly say what you do and who follows you — it makes matching you with the right campaigns easier.
onboarding.nichesHint: Brands filter by niche when they swipe. Pick the ones that fit your content so you show up for the right brands.
onboarding.staffNote: You are logged in as an administrator without an app profile — that is why you see this page.

campaigns.empty: No campaigns yet — create your first above.
campaigns.briefMessage: Your message to the creator — what's the collaboration?
campaigns.noShortlisted: No saved creators yet — swipe and save some first.

profile.title: Your profile
profile.channelsHint: Enter your username and approximate follower count per channel. Clear the username to remove a channel. Changing a username means the follower count must be verified again.
profile.listed: Your profile is visible to brands
profile.notListed: Your profile isn't visible yet — it's under review
profile.verifyHint: Upload a screenshot of your channel statistics (e.g. Instagram Insights) so we can confirm your follower counts. Verified profiles get a badge in the deck.
profile.verifyRejected: Your last request was rejected — try a clearer screenshot.

forBrands.title: Find creators your audience knows
forBrands.sub: Swipe through Danish nano and micro creators, save favorites privately, and pay only when you want to reach out.
forBrands.step1d: Build your shortlist of creators that fit your brand — completely free.
forBrands.step2d: Pay per campaign — no subscription, no lock-in.
forBrands.step3t: Send briefs and close the deal
forBrands.step3d: Negotiate the price back and forth, and chat once the deal is made.
forBrands.creatorInstead: Are you a creator? See how it works for you

forCreators.title: Get discovered by Danish brands
forCreators.sub: Free for creators. Build your profile once — brands swipe, save you, and reach out with real briefs.
forCreators.step1d: Photos, your niche, and your channels. Takes under three minutes.
forCreators.step2d: Brands save you privately to their lists. You only see counts — no inbox spam.
forCreators.step3d: You set your own price in the negotiation. No commission.
forCreators.brandInstead: Are you a business? See how it works for you

account.title: Account
account.hasPasswordHint: You can log in with both a one-time code and a password.
account.noPasswordHint: You currently log in with one-time email codes. Set a password if you prefer.

dashboard.ctaTitle: Run a campaign — or browse creators first?
dashboard.ctaBody: Activate a campaign now — or keep exploring the pool first.

creatorDash.ctaListedTitle: Your profile is live in the pool
creatorDash.ctaListedBody: New briefs land here when brands reach out. Keep your profile sharp — it's your shop window.
creatorDash.ctaNotListedBody: Profiles with a photo, social links and niches enter the pool where brands swipe.
creatorDash.hiddenTitle: Your profile isn't visible to brands yet
creatorDash.hiddenBody: Brands can only find you once your profile has at least one photo, a channel and a niche. Then we review it and add it to the pool.
creatorDash.pendingBody: The profile is complete but not yet visible to brands. We review new profiles manually, and you'll appear in the pool as soon as it's approved.

kvaekker.hint: Use the arrow keys — get the frog safely across the road.

welcomePrompt.title: Welcome to Kvæk!
welcomePrompt.body: You log in with a one-time email code — you're welcome to keep doing that. If you'd rather use a password, you can set one now. You can always change this under Account.

install.title: Get Kvæk as an app
install.hint: Install Kvæk on your home screen — it opens like an app.
install.iosHelp: In Safari: tap the Share button and choose “Add to Home Screen”.
install.macHelp: In Safari: click the Share button in the toolbar and choose “Add to Dock”.
